title.zh: 试一试，没提到的物品还在吗？
title.en: Try It: Does an Unmentioned Item Stay?

brief.zh: 草稿已有 2 只夹子和 1 把剪刀。任务是保留夹子、加 1 张标签、去掉剪刀。先只要求加标签，观察剪刀是否还在。
brief.en: The draft has 2 clips and 1 pair of scissors. Keep the clips, add 1 label, and remove the scissors. First ask only for the label and watch what happens to the scissors.

concept.zh: 在已有清单上添加用品时，明确排除不允许的内容。
concept.en: Explicitly exclude forbidden items when adding supplies to an existing list.

hints.zh: 用提示词卡分别试一次“标签：1张”和“去掉剪刀”。
hints.en: Try the cards “Label: 1” and “Remove scissors” in separate turns.
